## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising while SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling — mixed confirmations support a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Rising fear and commodity shock: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising and oil ETFs BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ↑ rising are the dominant drivers; credit proxies HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) → flat provide no clear easing.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-mixed: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +3.35%) ↓ falling week but + month, and HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) → flat — overall financial conditions show short-term volatility but no clear loosening or tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ↑ rising; Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) ↓ falling; Financials XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) ↓ falling — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities SLIPPING: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling, while EM and China underperform sharply — EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -0.39%) ↓ falling and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) ↓ falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed risk-on signals: IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +5.63% | 1M: -6.29%) ↑ rising, ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +0.77%) ↑ rising, but IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -0.16%) ↓ falling — speculative flows uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil-dominated commodity surge: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ↑ rising, USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) ↑ rising; copper CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.20% | 1M: +0.25%) ↓ falling shows mixed industrial signal, gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +10.46%) → flat.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strength intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ↑ rising; natural gas UNG RECOVERY (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.24%) ↑ rising but softer over the month.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy/oil leadership (XLE and BNO ABOVE TREND across 1W and 1M). DIVERGENCE: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising versus SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +3.35%) — mixed signals warrant neutrality.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor energy/commodity exposure (XLE (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND) and real assets; reduce exposure to China/EM equities (FXI (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND, EEM (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND) and monitor tech (XLK (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%) and XLRE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +6.84%) if oil momentum persists. BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.22% | 1M: -3.73%) and XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -4.68%) if risk sentiment stays fragile.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +21.55%) on supply-driven moves. BEARISH: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -2.20% | 1M: +0.25%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -5.87% | 1M: +4.00%) if growth concerns re-emerge.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~30 elevated (VXX (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ABOVE TREND) as a fear gauge, HYG/LQD spread ~wide (HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.27% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION) for credit health, SPY support near recent lows (SPY (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND), BNO momentum threshold (BNO (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with energy and select real assets showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +12.27%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.60% | 1M: +24.36%)). Key risk is rising fear and oil-driven volatility—VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +12.83%) ↑ rising versus SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling.
